{{Top|leg}}
'''King of the Tribes''' was the title of the leader of the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[King/Legends|King]] of the Tribes led the [[Terend council|Terend Council]] and worked with the [[Ufflor officer|ufflors]] to help all members of the species.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|218|King of the Tribes}}</ref>
